decisions.reason: The new tone and colour-palette review criteria concern editorial suitability of the images; they do not change whether chapter images are included or when they are integrated.
The source requests review of chapter images, not a change to the manuscript's textual editing objective or approved passage rewrites.
Reviewing chapter images for tonal and colour-palette consistency does not affect the title-page newline-artifact requirement.
The image-review criteria do not modify the separate obligation to advise the client on successful paperback publication.
The source concerns evaluation of chapter images and does not change which client-authored manuscript revision is authoritative or how highlighted revisions are integrated.
